"""Formatting-only preparation helper: preserve exact AST while wrapping long literals."""

import ast
import io
import json
import tokenize
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).parent
counts = {}
for path in sorted(root.glob("*.py")):
    original = path.read_text()
    source = original
    prior = ast.dump(ast.parse(source), include_attributes=False)
    changes = 0
    for _ in range(500):
        lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
        tokens = list(tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(source).readline))
        changed = False
        for token in tokens:
            if token.type != tokenize.STRING or token.start[0] != token.end[0]:
                continue
            index = token.start[0] - 1
            if len(lines[index].rstrip()) <= 100 or len(token.string) < 45:
                continue
            value = ast.literal_eval(token.string)
            if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) <= 56:
                continue
            indent = len(lines[index]) - len(lines[index].lstrip()) + 4
            chunks = [value[i : i + 56] for i in range(0, len(value), 56)]
            text = ("\n" + " " * indent).join(repr(x) for x in chunks)
            offset = sum(map(len, lines[:index]))
            start, end = offset + token.start[1], offset + token.end[1]
            for replacement in [text, "(" + text + ")"]:
                candidate = source[:start] + replacement + source[end:]
                try:
                    parsed = ast.dump(ast.parse(candidate), include_attributes=False)
                except SyntaxError:
                    continue
                if parsed == prior and candidate != source:
                    source = candidate
                    changes += 1
                    changed = True
                    break
            if changed:
                break
        if not changed:
            break
    assert ast.dump(ast.parse(source), include_attributes=False) == prior
    if source != original:
        path.write_text(source)
    counts[path.name] = changes
(root / "literal-wrap-assessment.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"AST_identical": True, "changed_literal_counts": counts}, indent=2) + "\n"
)
